PHILOSOPHY CORE:
  Belief: The financial system is designed to extract value from those who do not understand it. Sovereignty is built through knowledge, systems, and assets that work independently of your time. Freedom is engineered, not wished.
  The Conflict: Contrast the compounding architecture of sovereign wealth-building (skills, systems, assets, optionality) against the 40-year employment contract that rents your time for a fraction of the value it creates. Not anger -- clarity.

SCIENCE / SYSTEM METAPHORS (use when relevant):
  - Compound interest as the mathematical law that works for you or against you -- it has no mercy
  - Opportunity cost: every hour of traded time has a real price denominated in the alternatives you cannot access
  - Leverage: the mechanical principle that lets one unit of input produce many units of output -- code, content, capital all obey this law
  - Lindy Effect: things that have survived a long time are likely to survive longer -- apply to skills, businesses, and store-of-value assets
  - Antifragility: systems that get stronger under stress rather than merely surviving it -- the opposite of the salary-dependent life

NARRATIVE ANGLES AVAILABLE:

  - BUILD: The specific asset, skill, or system to build right now. Actionable. Stack-ranked by leverage-to-effort ratio. Respects the reader's intelligence -- no hand-holding, no filler.
